nieves.name: Casa Nieves
nieves.hover: Twin room with private bathroom and mountain views
nieves.desc: A cozy ground-floor room with two beds, air conditioning, and a private bathroom. Unwind with flat-screen TV and Netflix, then step outside to the outdoor dining area nestled in the tropical garden.

mochila.name: Casa Mochila
mochila.desc: A spacious mixed dormitory built for backpackers and group travelers. Five beds, shared bathroom with hairdryer, safe deposit boxes, and laundry on site. Step outside to the communal dining terrace and swap stories under the sky.

flores.name: Casa Flores
flores.hover: Double Room with private patio and garden views
flores.desc: Bright and comfortable with private access to a sun-drenched patio and terrace. Wake up to garden and inner courtyard views, enjoy your morning in the open air, and return to a private bathroom with all the comforts of home.

volcan.name: Casa Volcán
volcan.hover: Double Room with balcony and mountain views
volcan.desc: A scenic room with a private balcony and terrace framing mountain, garden, and city views. Air-conditioned with flat-screen TV and Netflix. Fall asleep to the silhouette of the volcano, wake to birdsong over the Ruta de las Flores.

hero.title: Neskapolita
hero.subtitle: Your refuge on the Ruta de las flores

story.desc: Step inside the family home that inspired a legacy of hospitality.

ruta.desc_1: Famous for its weekend food festival, cascading Los Chorros waterfalls, and active volcanic soil perfect for coffee.
ruta.desc_2: The highest town on the route, boasting mist-veiled coffee farms, extreme zip-lining, and the beautiful Green Lagoon.
ruta.desc_3: A vibrant town filled with pastel-colored street murals, boutique hand-craft shops, and high-altitude microbreweries.
ruta.desc_4: Famous for traditional steamed yucca served on banana leaves, towering mountain views, and local wood galleries.
ruta.desc_5: Home to ancestral indigenous wicker basketry and a beautiful candle-lit night market selling warm pupusas.
ruta.desc_6: The historical gateway to the highlands, rich in colonial landmarks and natural volcanic thermal pools.
